Messages.Author: Peter Laan
Messages.Body:
If one vampire plays laps (oposing minion can't strike), can the other play
a strike-maneuver card like thrown gate to get a maneuver?

Peter

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Peter Laan wrote:
>
> If one vampire plays laps (oposing minion can't strike), can the other play
> a strike-maneuver card like thrown gate to get a maneuver?

No. No strike -> no maneuver from a strike/weapon.
